verdict.rationale: Extend's parsing docs list a section on "Figures, charts, diagrams, and equations," and pricing claims image detection. Positional traceability is evidenced via extraction citations that "point back to the exact spot on the page" and community remarks on decent bounding-box demos. However, the evidence never details how figures are described or cropped, or that figure outputs specifically carry page coordinates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure/chart summaries, image crop output, figure-level bounding boxes/page references in parse chunks, and hands-on corroboration of figure parsing.
